hotspots.title: Flávio Bolsonaro Defeat & Brazil Election Fraud Claims
hotspots.blurb: Defeated Brazilian presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro fled to the United States via Argentina and Ecuador after defying a Supreme Court travel ban. Proclaiming himself Brazil's rightful leader from Florida while alleging electoral fraud, Bolsonaro's flight has triggered international legal friction and intense political fallout across South America and Washington.
hotspots.affect: Commands maximum affective charge due to dramatic self-exile claims, accusations of international conspiracy, and high-stakes legal investigations.

hotspots.title: Marine Le Pen Launches RN Campaign & Congress
hotspots.blurb: Marine Le Pen and Jordan Bardella lead the Rassemblement National's 2027 presidential momentum following their party congress in Orléans. The campaign is engulfed in fierce political crossfire over judicial ineligibility rulings, accusations of racism from President Macron, and viral media controversies over luxury items.
hotspots.affect: Commands high attention due to polarized political warfare, threat of judicial disqualification, and intense systemic establishment pushback.

hotspots.title: PiS Internal Crisis Over Kaczyński's Polexit Remarks
hotspots.blurb: Law and Justice (PiS) leader Jarosław Kaczyński ignited a severe political storm by floating a 'hard and risky' EU departure strategy as a fallback option at the Krynica Forum. Prime Minister Donald Tusk and opposition forces seized on the remarks, forcing PiS insiders to scramble between defending the hardline rhetoric and reassuring moderate voters.
hotspots.affect: Generates strong outrage and geopolitical alarm over Poland's European integration and sovereignty.

hotspots.title: Nigel Farage MP Altercation Row & Reform Campaign
hotspots.blurb: Reform UK leader Nigel Farage caused a major media firestorm by admitting he skipped the Commons Budget speech to avoid a physical altercation with a Liberal Democrat MP. Lib Dem MP Caroline Voaden accused Farage of shoving her, escalating partisan feuding alongside Reform UK's launch of its own mass-distributed print newspaper.
hotspots.affect: Drives disproportionate coverage through sensationalized parliamentary drama, personal conflict framing, and populist media offensive.

hotspots.title: Trump Midterm Rallies & Campaign Trail Violence
hotspots.blurb: Donald Trump and JD Vance continue an aggressive nationwide rally blitz targeting battleground state Senate races ahead of the midterms. The campaign push is punctuated by contentious crowd-size debates, abrupt event cancellations, and violent confrontations between protesters and right-wing speakers at Turning Point USA campus stops.
hotspots.affect: Commands intense emotional investment through high-stakes electoral anxiety and physical political confrontations on college campuses.
